CISA recommends all organizations: Install the relevant updated version of NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway as soon as possible. See Citrix ADC and Citrix Gateway Security Bulletin for CVE-2023-3519, CVE-2023-3466, CVE-2023-3467 for patch information.
